newsitem.title: USA: Cisco Systems, Wang in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Cisco Systems, Wang in alliance.

text.p: Wang Laboratories Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent with Cisco Systems Inc to become a global partner of Cisco.
Wang said the global partner status will allow it to supply its clients with Cisco products in authorized countries around the world. No financial terms of the deal were disclosed.
Wang, based in Billerica, Mass., made the announcement at the Networld + Interop '97 show in Las Vegas.
"We are very pleased to join forces with such a superb partner. Cisco Systems is a true market driver in networking," said Joseph Tucci, Wang's chairman and chief executive.
Wang shares were up one to 19-1/8 and Cisco's shares gained 1-7/8 to 59-1/8 in late morning trading.
